info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Replace Banking Employee Expense Claim By Expense Claim Id-v5-spec
info.description: The Update Employee Expense Claim API facilitates the modification of expense claims associated with banking employees. By providing the employee ID and the specific expense claim ID, users can adjust details such as claim amounts or descriptions. This API is primarily utilized by financial administrators and banking personnel who need to ensure accuracy in employee reimbursements and maintain proper expense records. It streamlines the expense management process, enhancing operational efficiency and compliance.

put.summary: Update an expense claim for an employee.
put.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific expense claim associated with an employee. You must provide the employee ID and the expense claim ID for the update to be applicable. Ensure that all required fields are included in the request body for successful processing.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the expense claim for the specified employee and expense claim ID. It should include all necessary details for the expense claim, ensuring that the data is structured according to the provided schema.
